samples.title: REAL: four-stage chain, Spark text -> Muse Image -> SAM 3.1 -> Spark vision (recorded 2026-11-02, scored 2026-11-03)
samples.description: Four-stage chain with three named Meta tools (Muse Spark, Muse Image, SAM 3.1). Steps 1 to 4 replay recorded run s1 (notification preferences with toggle switches and top tabs), recorded on 2026-11-02: Muse Spark text wrote the image prompt, Muse Image generated the UI screenshot, SAM 3.1 proposed 12 boxes over 4 phrases (HTTP 200 each), Muse Spark pure vision named all 12 numbered marks. Step 5 is the earlier 3-run footer, counts only. Steps 6 and 7 show MEASURED numbers from a later run on 24 synthetic AI-generated screenshots (exploratory, one seed, self-registered before the first model call) and a separately labelled post-hoc re-run; receipts IA-*. Replay only: steps replay recorded data and make no live model calls.
chain: Muse Spark text writes the image prompt
Muse Image generates the UI screenshot
Muse Spark vision names each numbered mark
Earlier run footer (3 runs, counts only)
Label recall on 24 synthetic images (MEASURED, IA-*)
Post-hoc re-run of the 4 failed images (NOT pre-registered, IA-*)

samples.title: REAL: SAM proposes, Spark chooses (recorded set-of-mark chain, solved task)
samples.description: Recorded set-of-mark chain on one SOLVED task (000006 of seed 41, dropdown, chain hit, direct miss): recorded voice transcript -> SAM 3.1 candidate boxes with numbered marks -> Muse Spark choice of one mark -> deterministic IoU check vs ground truth. Replay only; no live model calls. Synthetic screenshots; transcripts recorded from a prior chain run; small n. Fresh-seed confirmation: seed 41 (variant fixed in advance) 16 of 20 IoU>=0.5 vs 3 of 20 direct; seed 59 (pipeline frozen and pre-registered) 16 of 20 vs 3 of 20; seed 23: 12 of 20 vs 5 of 20, exploratory; checkbox elements remain a failure case.
chain: Run footer (3 seeds, n=20 per seed, exploratory)

samples.title: REAL: voice -> Muse Spark vision -> verify (recorded calls)
samples.description: Real Meta tool calls recorded on 2026-11-02 (pure vision, agent tools off): speech transcription, then Muse Spark finds the named element on a synthetic GUI screenshot, then a deterministic check against the generator's ground truth. Synthetic screenshots, TTS speech, small n; replay shows the recorded timings, not a live run. The hit column uses a loose rule (IoU>=0.5 or click point inside the target box); no row reaches IoU 0.5 on its own.
chain: Aggregate over every task in the run

samples.title: Reflex: recorded SAM + Spark chain, with measured detector numbers
samples.description: Reflex v0 on one SOLVED task from the recorded set-of-mark chain (task 000006 of seed 41): SAM 3.1 candidate boxes, numbered marks, Muse Spark choice of one mark. Steps 4 to 6 show MEASURED numbers from earlier runs: the Spark VLM-only baseline, SAM 3.1 refine and the YOLOX-nano detector (synthetic screenshots). Replay only; no live model calls.
